name: Phantom Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a billowing mass of dark purple wisps with Rotom's face peeking from a black hood and an orange cord tail
entry: A Rotom that slipped out of its appliance and swelled into a shadow. Only its plug is left to show what it was.
how: Use a Frayed Cord on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Shadow Ball in this form.
